evidenceCoverage.baselineDescription: No pre-adoption comparison is included; observations begin at adoption.
evidenceCoverage.reason: No comparable pre-adoption outcome evaluation is established for this contract.

caveat: The evidence measures post-adoption attainment only; without a comparable pre-adoption baseline it cannot establish improvement or causation.

intent.goal: Provision the example agent's contents, issues and pull-requests scopes at read level.
intent.acceptance: Inspect the actual immutable compiled agent-job permission map. Each of the three declared toolset read requirements must be exactly read; write grants are a separate safeguard. This is a configuration facet, not compiler-warning or live access verification.

evidence.opportunity: The frozen example's three read-scope obligations in each immutable compiled agent job.
filters: Read compiled YAML, not a source-frontmatter promise or successful workflow run.
An explicit agent-job map replaces the workflow-level map; only an absent job map inherits the workflow map.
Missing entries in an explicit map are none. Missing maps, aliases, macros and unsupported job shapes remain unknown.
Retain warning-demo-era values as retrospective current-policy diagnostics, never as failures of that intentional warning example.
Only the known read-only-demo intent era without agent write grants is comparable for this configuration facet.
Do not flag safe-output or conclusion-job write grants as agent permissions.
MCP read-only enforcement, token credentials, compiler warnings, live authorization, costs and workflow causation are not measured.
evidence.collection: Digest-checked public immutable source and compiled workflow blobs at adoption and weekly/cutoff endpoints.

model.architecture: Strict YAML parsing of retained compiled agent permission maps, with explicit intent-era comparability.
model.recommendation: Inspect scope mismatches and agent write grants; separately verify compilation and real scoped access.

metrics.name: Required read-scope mismatches
metrics.formula: Count contents, issues and pull-requests grants whose effective compiled agent-job level is not exactly read.

metrics.name: Compiled agent write grants
metrics.formula: Count write-valued entries in the agent's effective explicit permission map, not other jobs.
